I got these for my 4 year old and she LOVED them. Not only does she adore them, but absolutely every child who comes to our house gravitates towards them.  They are short enough for her to handle, but long enough to twirl around with. They come in fun, vibrant colors. They have withstood some solid, daily usage with no wear or tear whatsoever.

So simple but so much fun. My kids are a wide age range and both enjoy waving them around. The elder does "graceful" dances and the little brut flaps the ribbons around like propellers. They really get their imaginations going, which I love. A few broke in rough and inappropriate play between a six and two year old... To be expected. I'd buy them again.
Cheap and short. Too short, I just assumed they would be long like all others I've seen and didn't pay attention to the description. That's my fault but be aware. Not worth the price
I should have read the product details and reviews more closely. These were much too short for my 9-year-old. They're probably meant more for the 4-5 year-old age group.
These are VERY short.  I would spend the extra few dollars and order some of the longer ones from amazon.  These are more like a cat toy, and not for children.

These we're perfect for a one year old. They are shorter length whichb worked for us.
Great for preschoolers and other little kids that can't handle the 5-6 foot ones

reviews.t: Fun for the kids and dance routines
reviews.x: I have a lot of younger kids in the family who are always in the house on video games or watching T.V.  It was time for a change. So I got the gymnastic ribbons to get them outside and dance with them.  The kids have been having a blast. Who knew such a simple ribbon could have them out and excited about something besides video games.  The baton is a really hard plastic that has a grip at the bottom. There was a little bit of glue that seemed to be on the baton but it was not an excessive amount

My kids love these! My favorite thing about them is that they do not easily get tangled. My daughter has sensory issues and easily becomes frustrated when things don't work properly including ribbons wrapping around her. These really twirl and flow exceptionally well. The attachment and ribbon are very sturdy and can take a beating. The colors are vibrant and they are a great value. The ribbons are of great quality and look like they are made to last.  We are using these as a prop at my dance studio for our Alice in wonderland production so they do get put thru the ringer and so far have held up well.  They are a bit shorter then traditional ribbons which I actually love because my students don't get tangled in each other!

reviews.t: The handles are nice, have some weight to them and are rubbery
reviews.x: Only reason for the 4 vs 5 star rating is that 3 of the 5 ribbons were the correct length (39"), but 2 of them are much longer (close to 60")... but they shipped quickly and other than length are what I expected. The handles are nice, have some weight to them and are rubbery.

reviews.x: They are decent for the price and the children love them. The rubber things come off but slide right back on. I would have liked the ribbons to be shorter for smaller children but they still love them and it is a blessing to allow the children to be part of the worship service.

These ribbons are much nicer than any others I've had. I'm using them for a dance routine my choir is doing at the end of this month. We have practiced with them several times and none are showing any signs of wear! Very well made and a great price for the quality.

reviews.x: They're very short compared to the "real thing", but our 5-year old absolutely loves them. The short handle means she doesn't knock things off her shelves and the short-ish ribbon doesn't tangle like a super long one would.

reviews.x: These are both cheap in price and in quality but they are a great option for little dancers as the ribbon isn't too long and they aren't a huge investment. They have been much enjoyed by my 4 year old daughter and niece.

My kids love playing with these.  They were a favorite Christmas gift (and I love that they get indoor exercise running around with them).  Sometimes the red part of the handles falls off, but we just slide them back on.

Doesn't come with colors shown in pictures (more specifically,  no light pink). One of the plastic handles was cracking at the top of one of them, but for the price, I didn't expect top quality. The 4 others seem fine.

reviews.t: They are nicely made and so far have held up well
reviews.x: These were just what we were wanting! The kids use them during Praise and Worship in Children's Church!  They are nicely made and so far have held up well.  We are happy with our purchase and will probably buy more!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the ribbons are short, which works well for young children but is too short for older kids or adults.
Reviewers frequently describe the ribbons as fun and engaging, especially for kids, with vibrant colors and imaginative play.
Several reviewers praise the durability and flow, noting they hold up well and don't easily tangle.
Some reviewers feel the quality is cheap or not as expected, though a few consider it acceptable for the price.
A few reviewers mention receiving incorrect colors or broken ribbons during rough play.
